title: Returning shoes
instructions: Bir adam aldığı ayakkabıyı geri getiriyor. Sorun ve sonucu takip et.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hello. I bought these shoes on Saturday, but they hurt my feet.

script.speaker: a
script.text: I'm sorry. Have you worn them outside?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Hmm. We usually only take back shoes that haven't been worn outside. But I can change them for a bigger size.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes, please. I'm a forty-two. Maybe a forty-three is better.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Here you are. Try them on.

script.speaker: b
script.text: These are much more comfortable. Thank you!

questions.prompt: When did he buy the shoes?
questions.evidence: I bought these shoes on Saturday

questions.prompt: Why can't he get his money back?
questions.evidence: We usually only take back shoes that haven't been worn outside.
